summary: Search and retrieve tracks from Jamendo
description: Returns a list of tracks matching the supplied query parameters. Includes new fields like 'audiodownload_allowed' indicating if a download can be offered. For singles, album related fields may be empty. Use the 'include' parameter to retrieve extra objects (licenses, musicinfo, stats, lyrics). Beware that changing the first order from 'relevance' will discard the relevance ranking; use 'boost' to influence ranking without losing relevance.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The results formatting type.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wrap JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 200). 'all' still capped at 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the given field(s). Append _asc or _desc to specify direction. Rating orders force descending.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, response header includes 'results_fullcount' (total rows without limit/offset). May affect performance.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One or more track IDs.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A track name.

parameters.name: namesearch
parameters.description: Search a track by name (UTF‑8 string).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Select only tracks of a certain type. Default returns only album tracks.

parameters.name: album_id
parameters.description: One or more album IDs.

parameters.name: album_name
parameters.description: Album name.

parameters.name: artist_id
parameters.description: One or more artist IDs.

parameters.name: artist_name
parameters.description: Artist name.

parameters.name: content_id_free
parameters.description: Content ID free flag.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Release date interval (yyyy‑mm‑dd_yyyy‑mm‑dd).

parameters.name: featured
parameters.description: Filter for tracks selected by Jamendo team.

parameters.name: imagesize
parameters.description: Cover image size in pixels.

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: Audio streaming format.

parameters.name: audiodlformat
parameters.description: Audio download format; defaults to audioformat or mp32.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Search by one or more tags (AND logic).

parameters.name: fuzzytags
parameters.description: Search by one or more tags (OR logic).

parameters.name: acousticelectric
parameters.description: Specify if track is acoustic or electric.

parameters.name: vocalinstrumental
parameters.description: Specify if track is vocal or instrumental.

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Gender of the singer (if vocal).

parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: Track tempo classification.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Lyrics language (ISO 2‑letter code).

parameters.name: durationbetween
parameters.description: Track duration interval in seconds (from_to).

parameters.name: xartist
parameters.description: Find tracks similar to a non‑Jamendo artist.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free text search across track, album, artist and tags.

parameters.name: prolicensing
parameters.description: Only tracks in the single‑track commercial licensing program.

parameters.name: probackground
parameters.description: Only tracks in the background‑music commercial program.

parameters.name: ccsa
parameters.description: Filter for Creative Commons Share‑Alike licensed tracks.

parameters.name: ccnd
parameters.description: Filter for Creative Commons No‑Derivs licensed tracks.

parameters.name: ccnc
parameters.description: Filter for Creative Commons Non‑Commercial licensed tracks.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Append additional objects to each track result.

parameters.name: groupby
parameters.description: Aggregate results per artist or per album.

parameters.name: boost
parameters.description: When searching, boost the ranking using the selected metric.

responseFields.name: audiodownload
responseFields.description: Download URL; may be empty if not allowed.

responseFields.name: audiodownload_allowed
responseFields.description: Indicates whether the track can be downloaded.

responseFields.name: album_image
responseFields.description: Album cover image URL (empty for singles).

responseFields.name: tags
responseFields.description: List of tags associated with the track.

responseFields.name: licences
responseFields.description: License information when requested via include=licenses.

notes: The field 'audiodownload_allowed' must be checked before offering a download link; if false, 'audiodownload' will be an empty string.
When using the tracks endpoint for search, keep 'order=relevance' as the first order to preserve relevance ranking; otherwise the relevance order is lost.
Use 'boost' instead of changing the primary order if you want a specific metric to influence ranking while retaining relevance.
For singles album_id, album_name and album_image are empty; handle nullable values accordingly.
'include' can dramatically increase payload size; request only needed extra objects.
The 'groupby' parameter returns only one track per group (artist or album), the first in the natural order.
Audio format defaults: streaming -> mp31, download -> mp32 (if not overridden).
The 'featured' filter accepts 'true' or '1' as values.
